app.single_use.bind_did.reason: a single-use token bound to the person; it has no use once they are erased

app.session.did.reason: a signed-in browser session of the person; it ends when they are erased

app.oauth_session.did.reason: the person's OAuth token set; it has no use once they are erased

app.account.did.reason: the person's app account, including onboarding and the privacy notice version they dismissed (P2.12b); the row goes when they are erased

app.invite.inviter_did.reason: the invites the person asked for, with their sealed codes; they go when the person is erased

audit.event_body.subject.reason: the target of a moderation or security event; the side row is redacted, the hash chain stays (P1.15a)

audit.event_body.actor.reason: the person who caused a moderation or security event; redacted with the same side row as its subject (P1.15k, ADR 0043)

idx.account.did.reason: the person's index row; deleted on erasure, and its jobs, profile, cards and blob rows go with it by cascade

idx.account_job.did.reason: pending index work for the person; removed with their index row

idx.profile.did.reason: the person's indexed public profile record; removed with their index row

idx.page.did.reason: the person's indexed public page record; removed with their index row

idx.section.did.reason: the person's indexed public card records; removed with their index row

idx.record_blob.did.reason: the blobs the person's indexed records reference; removed with their index row

idx.dead_letter.did.reason: a failed index event or backfill for the person; it has no use once they are erased

mod.account_state.did.reason: a moderator's delist or suspension state for the person; the decision itself stays in the audit mod lane

idx.profile.uri.reason: the AT-URI of the person's own indexed record; it names their DID and goes with their index row

idx.page.uri.reason: the AT-URI of the person's own indexed record; it names their DID and goes with their index row

idx.section.uri.reason: the AT-URI of the person's own indexed record; it names their DID and goes with their index row

idx.record_blob.uri.reason: the AT-URI of the person's own indexed record; it names their DID and goes with their index row

idx.track_request.did.reason: the request to index a member who signed in; it goes when they are erased

app.discoverability.did.reason: the member's Search and AI choices for their public page (ADR 0062); they go when they are erased

app.image.did.reason: the member's stored images (ADR 0070): sizes, state and times; the rows go when they are erased, and the object prefix drafts/<did>/ with them once objects are written (P2.18 follow-up)

app.image_use.record_uri.reason: which of the member's records use each image; the rows go with their image when the member is erased

app.image_upload.did.reason: the member's upload times for the hourly and daily limits, kept a day; they go when the member is erased

app.image_record.did.reason: the last settled write on each of the member's card records (P2.19b), which orders picture settling; the rows go when the member is erased

app.image_record.record_uri.reason: the card record each of those rows is about; it goes with its row

app.notification.did.reason: the person's unopened notifications (P2.27, ADR 0079); they go when the person is erased

app.sign_in.did.reason: the times the person signed in, kept 30 days (P2.27c, ADR 0082); they go when the person is erased
